# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report security issues and bugs to **product@opensac.org** — not as a public issue. If the finding involves
student data, say so in the subject line so it is triaged first.

A useful report says what you did (the exact steps, and the account tier you were signed in as, or that you were signed
out), what you expected, what actually happened, and who could do what to whose data.

Full guidance, including what makes a report actionable, is in the documentation:
[Security → Reporting a vulnerability](https://blocks-doc.vercel.app/?path=/docs/security-reporting-a-vulnerability--docs).

## Scope

This repository is a hand-synced documentation mirror; the product itself lives in
`opensacorg/wicit` and `opensacorg/api-wicit-java`. Report findings in the application to the address above regardless of which repository you
found them in.
